title: Presentation-free encoding of internal modules on a constant coefficient slice
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes in universe $u$, $f:Y\to X$, $\Lambda$ a commutative condensed ring in universe $u+1$, and $k$ a commutative ring in universe $u+1$. Let $c:\underline{k}\simeq\operatorname{smallRing}(X,\Lambda_X)$ be a ring-sheaf isomorphism with the conventions of [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data] and [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules], and let $U$ be an object of the coefficient-sized pro-etale site of $Y$. Put $Z=U.\mathrm{left}$ and $g=f\circ U.\mathrm{hom}:Z\to X$. There is an equivalence $E$ from internal $\Lambda_Z$-modules to sheaves of $k$-modules on the coefficient-sized slice at $U$. For every internal $\Lambda_X$-module $N$, $E(g^*N)$ is isomorphic to the restriction to $U$ of the fixed-scalar inverse image along $f$ of $\operatorname{smallModules}(N)$ restricted along $c$. Here internal restriction is [def-sfb-point-model-restriction-module]. Moreover, $E$ sends the internal regular module $\Lambda_Z$ to the constant sheaf of the regular $k$-module [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. There are no finiteness, Noetherianity, discrete-coefficient, nonzero-ring, nonempty-scheme, presentation, or scalar-normalization assumptions.

source.place: Tags 03CY, lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules, and 04IX, definition-localize-ringed-site; Sites Tag 00YV, proposition-functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi; encoding steps of lem-sfb-constant-slice-internal-presentation.

proof.text: Use constant_coefficient_pullback_coordinates along the composite U.hom ≫ f to obtain dZ directly on U.left. The ring-coordinate obligation is the only remaining split step; it has no module or slice equivalence in its conclusion.

Use the proved global encoding at X and U.left. Apply its inverse-image comparison directly to U.hom ≫ f and dZ. The global theorem supplies its explicit functor equation and regular-module comparison. No coordinates or global encoding on Y are needed.

Use the proved coefficient-sized fixed-module slice equivalence. Compose it with the global encoding on U.left. Composition of the fixed-scalar inverse images, obtained from composition of their direct images by uniqueness of left adjoints, identifies inverse image along U.hom ≫ f with fixed-scalar inverse image along f followed by U.hom. The slice comparison then gives the required pointwise comparison. The global regular-module comparison and preservation of constants by the slice equivalence give the last assertion. Explicit proved object equations handle functor composition and point-model restriction without unfolding large module constructions.

proof_origin.place: Tags 00YV, 03CY and 04IX; direct transport along U.hom ≫ f, the proved global encoding, fixed-scalar inverse-image composition and slice localization. The internal-module compositor and intermediate Y encoding are unnecessary.

theorem constant_slice_module_encoding
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (k : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing k]
    (c : ConstantCompletion.constant (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X) k ≅
      smallRing X (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} Y) :
    ∃ E : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (AsSmall.down.obj U).left) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj Λ (AsSmall.down.obj U).left) ≌
      Sheaf ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y).over U)
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k),
      (∀ N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X),
        Nonempty (E.functor.obj (pointModelRestriction Λ f N (AsSmall.down.obj U).hom) ≅
          (((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, u} f k).obj
            ((coefficientModelFixedScalars _ k).obj
              ((smallModules X (condensedRingObj Λ X) ⋙
                ConstantCompletion.res c.hom).obj N))).over U))) ∧
      Nonempty (E.functor.obj (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ (AsSmall.down.obj U).left)) ≅
        (constantSheaf ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y).over U)
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)).obj (ModuleCat.of k k))
